title: Fix state version mismatch in spec modules
description:
modules/nixos/host-spec.nix and modules/home-manager/user-spec.nix declare default stateVersion = "25.05", but all NixOS and Home Manager configurations in flake.nix use stateVersion = "25.11". The spec defaults should match the actual state versions used. This mismatch means any new configuration created without explicitly overriding stateVersion will get the wrong default.

Files:
- modules/nixos/host-spec.nix:20: default = "25.05" (should be "25.11")
- modules/home-manager/user-spec.nix:19: default = "25.05" (should be "25.11")

title: Fix ISO network manager conflict between network.nix and default.nix
description:
hosts/iso/network.nix sets networking.networkmanager.enable = lib.mkForce false, but hosts/iso/default.nix has a comment saying 'Use NetworkManager for network config' and sets networking.networkmanager.enable = true. Since mkForce always wins in NixOS option resolution, networkmanager is effectively disabled despite the comment claiming it is enabled. The default.nix should use mkForce true to override network.nix, or network.nix should remove the mkForce.

Files:
- hosts/iso/network.nix:5: networkmanager.enable = lib.mkForce false
- hosts/iso/default.nix:23: networking.networkmanager.enable = true (comment says 'Use NetworkManager')

title: Remove placeholder GitHub issue reference in claude-code default.nix
description:
users/features/opt-in/claude-code/default.nix contains a comment referencing a placeholder GitHub issue URL: 'https://github.com/nix-community/home-manager/issues/XXXX'. Either replace XXXX with the actual issue number, or remove the comment if the workaround is no longer needed.

File:
- users/features/opt-in/claude-code/default.nix:22

title: Replace hardcoded paths in vscode.nix nixd configuration
description:
users/features/opt-in/vscode.nix hardcodes the path '/home/rona/Repositories/nix-repos/nix-config' in the nixd LSP configuration for nixos and home-manager options. This path is user-specific and repo-specific, making the config unusable if the repository is cloned elsewhere or under a different username. The path should be derived from the actual workspace or made configurable.

Lines in users/features/opt-in/vscode.nix:
- nixd.options.nixos.expr references '/home/rona/Repositories/nix-repos/nix-config'
- nixd.options.home-manager.expr references '/home/rona/Repositories/nix-repos/nix-config'

Note: This affects only the vscode.nix feature module for the aio configuration.
